throughput.label: LAYOUT-derived
throughput.note: One accepted sample per clock cycle (in_valid every cycle) is the RTL's maximum; at the achieved clock that is 10.0 Msample/s aggregate over all channels (1.25 Msample/s per channel if the 8 channels are time-multiplexed evenly). The record path emits at most one record per cycle; HYBRID mode generates two records per sample, so the arbiter and FIFO, not timing, bound sustained HYBRID throughput at one record per cycle.
